mapper.select: SELECT act02_journal_id AS journal_id , act02_company_id AS company_id , act02_date AS date , act02_journal_no AS journal_no , CAST(act02_journal_no AS varchar) AS journal_no_str , act02_corp_id AS corp_id , act02_corp_nm AS corp_name , f_cdnm('trCode', act02_tr_cd, act02_company_id, act02_date) AS tr_name , note , COALESCE(act02_cur_cd, 'KRW') AS cur_code , act02_journal_amt AS journal_amt , act02_person_nm AS person_name , f_get_relate_dcr_count(act02_journal_id) || ' 건' AS dcr_count_str , COALESCE(act02_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS fix_yn , act02_fix_yn_nm AS fix_yn_name , act02_fix_person_nm AS fix_person_name , act02_fix_date_str AS fix_date_str FROM ( SELECT act02_journal.* , f_emp_kor_nm(act02_person_id) AS act02_person_nm , f_get_journal_corp_nm(act02_journal_id) AS act02_corp_nm , CASE WHEN coalesce(act02_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '승인' ELSE '' END AS act02_fix_yn_nm , COALESCE(( SELECT sum(act03_dr_amt) FROM act03_journal_dtl WHERE act03_journal_id = act02_journal_id ), 0) AS act02_journal_amt , to_char(act02_fix_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') AS act02_fix_date_str , f_get_journal_tr_cd(act02_journal_id) AS act02_tr_cd , f_get_journal_note(act02_journal_id) AS note FROM act02_journal LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = act02_corp_id WHERE act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act02_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND COALESCE(CAST(sys15_corp_id AS VARCHAR), '') || '' LIKE #{corpIdStr} AND ( ( #{unFixYn} = 'true' AND coalesce(act02_fix_yn, 'false') = 'false' ) OR ( #{unFixYn} = 'false' ) ) ) t LEFT OUTER JOIN ast05_tr_code ON (ast05_company_id = act02_company_id AND ast05_tr_cd = act02_tr_cd) WHERE act02_tr_cd LIKE #{trCode} AND COALESCE(ast05_tr_occ_type, '') LIKE #{trOccType} AND UPPER(CONCAT(act02_corp_nm , f_cdnm('trCode', act02_tr_cd, act02_company_id, act02_date) , note , COALESCE(act02_cur_cd, 'KRW') )) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchText}) || '%' ORDER BY act02_date, act02_journal_no

SELECT act02_journal_id AS journal_id , act02_company_id AS company_id , act02_date AS date , act02_journal_no AS journal_no , CAST(act02_journal_no AS varchar) AS journal_no_str , act02_corp_id AS corp_id , f_get_journal_corp_nm(act02_journal_id) AS corp_name , f_cdnm('trCode', f_get_journal_tr_cd(act02_journal_id), act02_company_id, act02_date) AS tr_name , f_get_journal_note(act02_journal_id) AS note , COALESCE(act02_cur_cd, 'KRW') AS cur_code , COALESCE(( SELECT sum(act03_dr_amt) FROM act03_journal_dtl WHERE act03_journal_id = act02_journal_id ), 0) AS journal_amt , f_emp_kor_nm(act02_person_id) AS person_name , f_get_relate_dcr_count(act02_journal_id) || ' 건' AS dcr_count_str , COALESCE(act02_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS fix_yn , CASE WHEN coalesce(act02_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '승인' ELSE '' END AS fix_yn_name , act02_fix_person_nm AS fix_person_name , to_char(act02_fix_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') AS fix_date_str FROM act02_journal WHERE act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act02_journal_id = #{journalId}
mapper.update: UPDATE act02_journal SET act02_fix_yn = CASE WHEN #{procType} = 'P' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END , act02_fix_person_nm = CASE WHEN #{procType} = 'P' THEN #{fixPersonName} ELSE null END , act02_fix_date = CASE WHEN #{procType} = 'P' THEN f_sysdate() ELSE null END WHERE act02_journal_id = #{journalId}
